foci.correctness: correctness and logic (state and effects, control flow, edge cases, stale closures)
foci.dataContract: data contracts (API response shapes, field naming, types matching what the backend really returns)
foci.security: security (XSS, unsafe HTML, tokens in storage or URLs, client-side-only authorization)
foci.performance: performance (needless re-renders, unmemoized work in render, bundle weight, request waterfalls)
foci.errorHandling: error handling and user feedback (failed requests, loading and empty states, error boundaries)

highRiskSurface: auth and session handling, payment flows, routes guarded by role
